title: The status pill keeps the saved status while another is picked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: an Admin, who has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • [Loc-1] = the location you work in (pick it in the location switcher in the top bar).
  • Data at [Loc-1]: one active part [Part-A] and one inactive part [Part-B].

Setup

  1. Write down: [Part-A] = ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PILLKEEP-01 and [Part-B] = ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PILLKEEP-02 (examples).
  2. Sign in as the Admin and pick [Loc-1] in the location switcher in the top bar.
  3. At [Loc-1]: Parts → Inventory → New Inventory Part → Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL Pill Keep A → Part Number: [Part-A] → Category: any (e.g. Uncategorized) → Cost: 10.00 → Sell Price: 20.00 → keep the default bin row (Quantity e.g. 3) → Save.
  4. At [Loc-1]: Parts → Inventory → New Inventory Part → Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL Pill Keep B → Part Number: [Part-B] → Category: any (e.g. Uncategorized) → Cost: 10.00 → Sell Price: 20.00 → keep the default bin row (Quantity e.g. 3) → Save.
  5. At [Loc-1]: Parts → Inventory → Active tab → search [Part-B] → click the row → Part Status: Inactive → Save → click Deactivate in the 'Deactivate part?' window.
  6. Check the setup worked: [Part-A] on the Active tab, [Part-B] on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Active tab → click the [Part-A] row.
  2. Click the Inactive option.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Inactive tab → click the [Part-B] row.
  5. Click the Active option.
  6. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the title row pill still reads "Active" in green.
  • Step 5: the title row pill still reads "Inactive" in grey.
